== Research Notes ==
Charles’s paper records County Kildare as his native place and Julie’s paper says the same place as her husband. The native-place wording does not prove the children’s or ancestors’ birthplaces. Charles’s November 1800 statement concerns his baptism, not an exact birth. Julie’s age 38 in December 1840 conflicts with her sworn birth in December 1801; her approximate year remains qualified. Julie’s maiden surname Burns remains unverified. Charles’s mother is Anne Du[?]e, not his wife; the surname is not expanded. The two fathers called Thos are separate source actors: Charles’s father is a labourer, Julie’s a farmer. No marriage of either grandparent couple is inferred. Certification-column dates are not birthdays, and Daniel’s faint 20 October 1829 annotation is not independent birth proof. No exact Daniel birthday or existing vital field is corrected.

Age-derived approximate year, not exact birthday; Charles baptism November 1800 and Julie conflicting age/sworn birth retained.

Parental roles involving newly catalogued source actors have their first measurements in this review; those measurements are review coverage, not improvements from earlier measured confidence. Only the existing adult Daniel’s newly selected parents are a new attachment finding. No wider cross-branch join or untraced adult identity is established.
